analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($355.59) vs SMA5 ($360.71)/SMA20 ($392.90)/SMA50 ($386.66): below short/mid-term trends, indicating weakness.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($397.02)/SMA200 ($368.35): maintaining mid-to-long-term trend weakness.
· 52-week position (32.9%) + approaching historical low range at current price level.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (35.3→34.4): continued oversold, bearish momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (histo -4.7630→-6.0012): worsening, indicating bearish expansion.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $343.39): approaching lower band, potential for increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($335.51): based on Pivot S1 ($326.20) and 52-week low ($287.17).
· Swing resistance ($359.49): based on 5-day high ($375.13) and SMA5 ($360.71), potential for short-term bounce on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (No Higher Low, No Lower High): sideways range, trend reversal uncertainty.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.84x): reduced confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): await RSI oversold exit and MACD improvement for buy entry.
